name: uvm-tunnel.public.dappnode.eth
description: Urbit Ship Tunnel — private-development Cloudflare connector source for a separately managed UVM ship. Blank token and absent public origin CA intentionally prevent activation/build. Schema checks do not establish installability or backend readiness.
gettingStarted:
**Urbit Ship Tunnel** connects a separately managed UVM ship to an owner-managed Cloudflare Tunnel. It does not run or start a ship and must not expose UVM's private administration.

A public ship route requires an owner-supplied tunnel token, an approved image with the origin's public CA certificate, and one exact ship-only route with strict HTTPS verification. Installing the connector alone does not create a tunnel, DNS record, or route. Follow the [origin route contract](https://github.com/OwlWilderness/dappnode-urbit-ship-tunnel#origin-route-contract) before publishing. Keep credentials out of source and chat.

warnings.onInstall: Development source only. Configure only through the private native Dappnode UI after backend TLS and routing readiness. The token is administrator-readable Docker environment, not a portable secret vault. Never publish the route before backend readiness.
